title: DoorwayOperatorBindingView
description: Denormalized read shape for active doorway-operator authority. Source of truth: derived from rea_commitments where action='operate-doorway' and state='active' (Operational, Category C — reconstructed from the notarized Commitment entry type, no new physical projection table). Each binding ties an operator agent to a single doorway with a capability set, scope, and succession role. The doorway's auth layer queries this view at JWT refresh time and embeds the capability snapshot into the issued token.

commitmentId.description: rea_commitments.id of the underlying Commitment entry.

doorwayId.description: The doorway this operator authority applies to. Parsed from in_scope_of (the 'doorway:<id>' entry). MUST match an existing DoorwayRegistration.id.

operatorAgent.description: Agent public key of the operator (Commitment.provider).

capabilities.description: Active capability strings carried by this binding (Commitment.resource_classified_as).

successionRole.description: Role within the doorway's succession plan (parsed from Commitment.metadata_json).

reachScope.description: Who can audit this binding (parsed from Commitment.metadata_json).

agreementId.description: The doorway's stewardship Agreement (Commitment.clause_of). One Agreement umbrellas all operator commitments for a doorway.

hasBeginning.description: ISO8601 — when this operator authority takes effect.

hasEnd.description: ISO8601 — when this operator authority lapses (null = open-ended).

dhtAnchorHash.description: ActionHash of the underlying Commitment entry on the DHT. Category A discipline: a binding without dht_anchor_hash is invalid.

custodyAttestationHash.description: ActionHash of the current HardwareCustodyAttestation this operator binding serves under. Null during the schemaVersion=1 transition window; non-null once the doorway has bootstrapped its custody attestation. The auth resolver compares this against the latest valid custody attestation for the doorway; mismatch indicates the binding is orphaned by a custody transition and the caller MUST re-authenticate.

stewardAttestationHash.description: ActionHash of the current StewardOfRecordAttestation this operator binding serves under. Null during transition. Independently revocable from custody; a stewardship transfer orphans operator commitments without affecting custody.

createdAt.description: ISO8601 — when this binding was projected.
